shared_elements: incised/carved linear decoration on a stone surface
justification: A depicts a figural scene in relief: a large standing human figure in profile with headgear and staff-like attribute above a smaller crouching/kneeling figure, framed within a tall rectangular panel. B shows no figures at all, only an allover field of incised geometric hatching (chevron- and lozenge-filled triangular patches) covering a rounded vessel body; the only thing in common is that both surfaces bear cut lines, which is not iconographic correspondence.
